_comment: Project-scoped MCP servers. Claude Code expands ${VAR} here, so no secrets are stored in this file. Servers must be approved on first use.

arxiv._comment: blazickjp/arxiv-mcp-server (Apache-2.0). Search arXiv, read author-submitted LaTeX, traverse citation graph. No API key. Cache is outside the repo so PDFs are never committed.

papers._comment: openags/paper-search-mcp (MIT). Unified search over Crossref, OpenAlex, DBLP, Semantic Scholar, arXiv, PMC, Zenodo, Unpaywall. Only the Unpaywall e-mail is required; the API keys are optional rate-limit boosters. Do NOT use its Sci-Hub fallback.
